name: @dudousxd/nestjs-catalog-secrets-vault
description: HashiCorp Vault Transit secret vault for @dudousxd/nestjs-catalog: connection credentials encrypted by Vault, so the key never reaches the application and rotation never reaches the database.
author: Davide Carvalho
//sideEffects: Safe to be false: nothing runs at import time. Every export is a declaration, a pure function or a factory, and the first network call happens on the first seal or open.
//dependencies: There are none, and for this package that is a feature rather than an accident. Every credential in the catalog passes through this code, so its transitive dependency set is its supply-chain blast radius. The whole Vault surface used here is three JSON POSTs over the global fetch — see src/http.ts for why node-vault was not worth a package.
//engines: 18 is where global fetch became available unflagged enough to rely on, and AbortSignal.timeout landed in 17.3. A host on an older runtime can still use this by passing its own `fetch`.
